_README: Routing parameters for this project: who does which kind of work. CLAUDE.md points here instead of repeating the table, so this file is the one place to change it. Copy it into another project and edit the values there - per-project routing is the reason it is data and not prose. Nothing parses this automatically; the agent reads it, so keep the strings meant for a reader.

axes._note: Two different things that look alike. A subagent model is picked from the Agent tool's enum. A worker is a separate process reached through a wrapper in Bash. GLM has no subagent form - model: 'glm' matches nothing.

lead.covers: design, plans, briefs, consolidation, final review
lead.escalate_when: the task is hard enough to earn it

verify.covers: re-verification and adversarial checks of any result
verify.constraint: never the model that produced the result being checked

artifact_execution.covers: execution whose deliverable is an artifact, and tasks matching agy's own skills
artifact_execution.why_driver: a thin subagent holds agy's long answer out of the lead's context, where it would otherwise be re-sent on every later turn

execution.covers: every other executable task: sweeps across files, implementing an approved plan, mechanical passes, long drafts

glm.run_from: a checkout root - the permission entry is matched against the command text, not the file on disk
glm.cost_caveat: large_multifile_task is null because it has not been measured. Do not borrow agy's multiplier. total_cost_usd in the wrapper's report is not a Z.AI charge - Claude Code prices it from a table with no GLM entry.

agy.quota: personal Google AI Pro, refills every five hours

choose_between_workers: GLM unless the job wants agy's own skills, or unless GLM's quota is the one you would rather not spend right now. agy's is the scarcer of the two.

haiku.what: the harness's own service slot - auto mode's command-safety classifier, and similar background calls
haiku.why: when that slot names a model the session cannot reach, running commands stops working while file reads carry on. The session holding the bad value cannot fix itself, because settings are read once at startup.

unverified.glm_is_opus_tier: GLM fills the slot an opus-tier worker would otherwise hold. That is a routing decision, not a measured equivalence - nothing here has benchmarked GLM against Opus 5. Replace this entry with a number the day someone does.
